# The wasm regressions (S8, Q-S8-12 (a)). `make check` builds
# test/wasm/hash.lang, gives the NAME ARGS part of each row to build/wasmtool
# and compares the output with the RESULT parts. A row is
# `NAME ARGS => RESULT`. `hashw x y` is the SHA-256 digest of the 64 bytes of
# x and y (each U256 big endian), as a big endian U256. Each digest came one
# time from `xxd -r -p | shasum -a 256` on the 64 bytes.
